patterns.title: AAL2 device-session bootstrap must not require an RLS-protected SELECT
patterns.rootCause: A representation-returning INSERT for a newly bootstrapped device session conflicted with the table's hardened active-session SELECT RLS predicate after successful TOTP authentication.
patterns.prevention: Preserve owner+AAL2 checks and an INSERT with explicit revoked_at:null and Prefer:return=minimal; cover the post-MFA bootstrap and RLS failure boundary.

patterns.title: Imported Lending data must be normalized at runtime
patterns.rootCause: Lending selectors treated unvalidated historical JSON as if TypeScript types had already validated person, entries, dates and numeric fields.
patterns.prevention: Normalize or skip malformed legacy rows at the selector boundary; preserve valid/minimal receivable summary semantics without logging financial payloads.

patterns.title: Shared form controls must not drift into page-specific skins
patterns.rootCause: Default input/control styling diverged across Quick Entry, authentication and editors instead of sharing design-system primitives and semantic tokens.
patterns.prevention: Modify the shared primitive/token owner, inspect sibling consumers and verify Light/Dark, focus, invalid, disabled and relevant responsive states.

patterns.title: CI fan-out should not repeat expensive checks on every UI correction
patterns.rootCause: High-churn pushes and overlapping workflow ownership generated redundant full validation, even where review-ready gates or a single owner were sufficient.
patterns.prevention: Keep core CI and security gates; defer heavy rendered/performance/Windows checks to final review head, cancel superseded runs, and run targeted local preflight first.
